scenarios.title: The Buildout
scenarios.description: AI infrastructure expansion collides with power and supply constraints.

scenarios.title: The Fire Nation Attacks
scenarios.description: The hundred-year war ignites in earnest. Everyone knows to buy the war machine — the war has other ideas.

scenarios.title: Mormons Go Nuclear
scenarios.description: Deseret goes atomic with a fleet of desert reactors. Ask why. The faithful are prepared — the market only thinks it is.

scenarios.title: Mr. Frog Becomes President
scenarios.description: The nation's most famous amphibian runs for the highest office. The scandal trades easy — the forgiveness is where the money is.
